lines.translation: then God comes and resolves his affairs. ||1||
Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O mortal man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee na simarahu dukh bha(n)janaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Why not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag si(n)gh rahai ban maahi ||
lines.translation: As long as the tiger lives in the forest,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab lag ban phoolai hee naahi ||
lines.translation: the forest does not flower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab hee siaar si(n)gh kau khaai ||
lines.translation: But when the jackal eats the tiger,
then the entire forest flowers. ||2||
The victorious are drowned, while the defeated swim across.
By Guru's Grace, one crosses over and is saved.
Slave Kabeer speaks and teaches:
remain lovingly absorbed, attuned to the Lord alone. ||3||6||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satar saii salaar hai jaa ke ||
lines.translation: He has 7,000 commanders,
and hundreds of thousands of prophets;
He is said to have 88,000,000 shaykhs,

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chhapan kot jaa ke khel khaasee ||1||
lines.translation: and 56,000,000 attendants. ||1||
I am meek and poor - what chance do I have of being heard there?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: majalas door mahal ko paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His Court is so far away; only a rare few attain the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
He has 33,000,000 play-houses.
His beings wander insanely through 8.4 million incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa aadam kau kichh nadar dikhaaee ||
lines.translation: He bestowed His Grace on Adam, the father of mankind,
who then lived in paradise for a long time. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dil khalahal jaa kai jarad roo baanee ||
lines.translation: Pale are the faces of those whose hearts are disturbed.
They have forsaken their Bible, and practice Satanic evil.
One who blames the world, and is angry with people,
shall receive the fruits of his own actions. ||3||
You are the Great Giver, O Lord; I am forever a beggar at Your Door.
If I were to deny You, then I would be a wretched sinner.
Slave Kabeer has entered Your Shelter.
Keep me near You, O Merciful Lord God - that is heaven for me. ||4||7||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਊਹਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh koee chalan kahat hai oohaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Everyone speaks of going there,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jaanau baiku(n)th hai kahaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: but I do not even know where heaven is. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap aap kaa maram na jaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: One who does not even know the mystery of his own self,
speaks of heaven, but it is only talk. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag man baiku(n)th kee aas ||
lines.translation: As long as the mortal hopes for heaven,
he will not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||2||
Heaven is not a fort with moats and ramparts, and walls plastered with mud;
I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ||3||
Says Kabeer, now what more can I say?
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven itself. ||4||8||16||
How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dovar kot ar tevar khaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It has double walls and triple moats. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਆਡੀ ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paa(n)ch pachees moh mad matasar aadee parabal maaiaa ||
lines.translation: It is defended by the five elements, the twenty-five categories, attachment, pride, jealousy and the awesomely powerful Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan gareeb ko jor na pahuchai kahaa karau raghuraaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The poor mortal being does not have the strength to conquer it; what should I do now, O Lord? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam kivaaree dukh sukh daravaanee paap pu(n)n daravaajaa ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire is the window, pain and pleasure are the gate-keepers, virtue and sin are the gates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: krodh pradhaan mahaa bad du(n)dar tah man maavaasee raajaa ||2||
lines.translation: Anger is the great supreme commander, full of argument and strife, and the mind is the rebel king there. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: svaad sanaah top mamataa ko kubudh kamaan chadhaaee ||
lines.translation: Their armor is the pleasure of tastes and flavors, their helmets are worldly attachments; they take aim with their bows of corrupt intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa teer rahe ghat bheetar iu gadh leeo na jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The greed that fills their hearts is the arrow; with these things, their fortress is impregnable. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem paleetaa surat havaaee golaa giaan chalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: But I have made divine love the fuse, and deep meditation the bomb; I have launched the rocket of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: braham agan sahaje parajaalee ekahi chot sijhaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: The fire of God is lit by intuition, and with one shot, the fortress is taken. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh lai larane laagaa tore dui daravaajaa ||
lines.translation: Taking truth and contentment with me, I begin the battle and storm both the gates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat ar gur kee kripaa te pakario gadh ko raajaa ||5||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and by Guru's Grace, I have captured the king of the fortress. ||5||
